facts.fact: The outgoing director-general said that under his leadership (February 2025 to August 2026) the Directorate signed a memorandum of understanding in Nairobi aimed at establishing an integrated civil registry system for recording births, deaths and marriages; the document gives no date for the signing, so the published date is used.

The memorandum of understanding for an integrated civil registry system was signed by the Directorate of Civil Registry, Nationality, Passport and Immigration under its director-general, by his own account at the 10 August 2026 handover; the counterparty is not named.
